thread:
sam: Quick WFH hack: propping my laptop on a cooling rack + a shoebox to get the webcam higher. aesthetic = 'I run a bakery' :bread: pic: https://imgur.com/a/fakeimage 

priya: Haha brilliant. ergonomics + crusty vibes. love it. :chef_tone1: 

sam: Also, random regression today 609 4a5 4bb my home internet dropped mid-standup for ~2 minutes. ISP status page shows "network blip" which is thrillingly helpful. anyone seen this pattern (drops ~every 6 hours)? 

dylan: If it's periodic it could be a scheduled re-synch on the fiber node or a flaky power inject. Ask ISP for logs around the timestamps. 

sam: here's a speedtest I ran right after the outage: 
```
Server: Local ISP (Newark)
Ping: 34 ms
Download: 8.76 Mbps
Upload: 0.94 Mbps
Jitter: 12 ms
Packet loss: 0%
```

zoe: upload under 1 Mbps ouch. for video calls that will cause degradation. Have you tried a phone tether as a quick fallback? 

sam: did a tether for the rest of the standup, worked fine. I want to fix the root cause though. ran `mtr -r -c 30 1.1.1.1` and saw consistent latency jump at hop 4 then timeouts at hop 6. feels ISP-side. 

priya: Yeah that's ISP. Also running a simple cron to ping 8.8.8.8 every 5m and log results helps when opening a ticket. 

ops-bot: FYI: Reminder to register any planned office-side network changes with eng-infra by EOD Friday. (This is an automated message) :robot_face: 

sam: Good idea. I'll start logging and call support if it recurs tonight. 

dylan: Snack poll: what fuels your WFH marathon? 1) espresso 2) green tea 3) cheesy crackers 4) suspiciously healthy smoothie 

zoe: 1 then 3. 

priya: 2 for low-caffeine afternoons. 

sam: 4 when pretending I care about my gut microbiome. :salute: 

dylan: Post before/after pic of the shoebox rig please, we demand documentation. :camera_with_flash:
